verses.text: “Sing, you who couldn't have children, you who never gave birth! Break out singing and shout, you who never went through labor. The woman left alone will have more children than the married woman,” says the LORD.
“Make more room for your tent. Stretch your curtains out wide and don't hold back. Lengthen the ropes and drive the stakes in strong.
You'll spread to the right and left. Your children will take possession of nations and settle in cities that were empty.
“Don't be scared. You won't be put to shame. Don't be embarrassed. You won't be disgraced. You'll forget the shame of your youth and won't remember the disgrace of being a widow anymore.
The one who made you is your husband. His name is the LORD of Armies. The Holy One of Israel is the one who redeems you. He'll be called the God of the whole earth.
The LORD called you like a wife who's been left behind and hurt deep down, like the wife of someone's youth who was sent away,” says your God.
“I left you for a little while, but I'll gather you back with great mercy.
In a rush of anger I hid my face from you for a moment. With faithful love that lasts forever, I'll have mercy on you,” says the LORD who redeems you.
“This is like the floodwaters of Noah to me. I swore those waters would never cover the earth again. In the same way I've sworn I won't be angry with you or rebuke you.
Mountains may move and hills may disappear, but my faithful love won't leave you, and my covenant of peace won't be taken away,” says the LORD, who has mercy on you.
“You've suffered, been tossed around by storms, and had nobody to comfort you. Look, I'll set your stones in beautiful colors and lay your foundations with sapphires.
I'll make your towers out of rubies, your gates out of sparkling jewels, and all your walls out of precious stones.
The LORD will teach all your children, and they'll have deep peace.
You'll be set on a foundation of righteousness. Oppression will be far away, and you won't live scared. Terror won't come near you.
People might gather against you, but I won't be the one sending them. Whoever gathers against you will fall because of you.
“Look, I made the blacksmith who fans the coals till they blaze and hammers out a weapon for its work. I also made the destroyer who tears things down.
No weapon made against you will win. You'll prove every voice that accuses you in court wrong. That's the inheritance of the LORD's servants, and their righteousness comes from me,” says the LORD.
